body: Built on the Mercedes Sprinter 144 AWD platform, The Northrop is our El Capitan Tier 5 flagship designed for serious, full time adventure. This van blends long range off grid capability with refined, home level comfort. A large lithium power system, four season protected plumbing, and premium finishes make daily living easy, while rugged exterior upgrades and suspension enhancements keep it confident on remote roads and backcountry terrain.Electrical

• 33 gallon fresh tank over wheel well with heat pad and level sensor• Heated greywater system• Air Head Classic composting toilet enclosure with exterior vent and dedicated power• Tetravan Folding Shower 2.1 with magnetic curtain• Quick connect outdoor shower• Electric water heater
• Premium wool insulation package with full plumbing protection• Maxxair Deluxe roof fan• 12V roof mounted AC unit• Espar diesel heater
